title: Require Domain Operation Implementation Artifact Boundary
forbids: operation entrypoints, semantic strategy implementations, or rules importing artifact catalogs, artifact owner modules, or reconstructing types from artifact schemas
why: Artifact payloads and operation envelopes are distinct owner-local containers. Reaching from implementation code into artifact authority creates a second schema edge; moving that whole payload into an atom only hides the same coupling. Implementations should express their actual private working shape and compose only smaller shared primitives or cohesive subentities.
remediate: Keep algorithm-only Params/Result types local, move only genuinely shared schema primitives or cohesive subentities to the nearest model/atoms owner, and make implementations and rules consume those without importing artifact catalogs or owner modules. Do not recreate a full artifact payload atom as a type escape hatch.
message: Operation implementation code must use private working types and smaller model atoms, never artifact schemas, catalogs, or payload-shaped atom aliases.
